title: 第1413章 前往中天域第1412章 声东击西回首掏
slug: 厨神把师姐们喂成女帝
content_zh:
“不知陛下这些新路的材料可有什么名字？我怎么从未见过？”
贾德很快就调整好了心态，笑呵呵的发出提问。
楚成大大方方的介绍道，“这可是好东西，便宜的不像话，而且结实耐用，你看看百姓们的车马在上面跑的多快啊…”
这家伙啰里啰嗦夸了沥青路半天，就是没提名字这茬。
一边的书记官奋笔疾书，一丝不苟的记下所有细节！
这可都是皇帝陛下的‘丰功伟绩’！
临了，楚成才从边上接过一杯茶水润了润喉咙，说道，
“这东西叫沥青，用处大着呢！”
见贾德脸上的笑容已经有些僵住了，楚成心里冷笑。
你老小子不是喜欢当笑面虎么，那就一直笑下去好了。
给你笑成面瘫！
“沥青…”
贾德眼中闪过一丝惊讶，像是想到了什么。
楚成见状故意问道，“贾盟主如此表情，莫非是以前听说过沥青这东西？这可是林神厨最近开发出来的材料，你说他一个厨师不研究菜谱，倒研究上这些东西了，也是有趣。”
之前林东方已经和他说过，只要有人问就大方说是黑石城买的，不需要藏着掖着。
贾德连连摇头，“从未听说过沥青这种东西。”
楚成心里哼了一声，贾德这话得反着听，他说没听说过，那就是听说过。
‘贾德如此表情，恐怕是在什么地方偶然见过这个名字，估计等下就要急着走了。’
果不其然，贾德一拱手说道，“今日路过幽国特来叨扰，现在我要…”
“哎，贾盟主说的什么话，太客气了，这怎么算是叨扰，来来来，你我兄弟去安静去处聊聊。”

楚成满脸笑容，像对待亲兄弟一样抓着贾德的胳膊，往皇城方向拽。
见到皇城方向那浩瀚人气凝结出的护城皇道龙气，贾德脸都绿了。
那玩意不是杀阵，却胜过杀阵！
贾德脚底在沥青路上留下两道沟壑，硬是被楚成给拽进了皇城。
进了书房，楚成挥散了手下大小官员，神秘兮兮的对贾德说道，
“贾盟主，我怀疑林东方那厮是域外天魔之一啊！”
“何以见得？”
贾德一愣，他没想到楚成给他弄过来是为了聊这茬。
聊这个他可就不想走了。
要是能实锤林东方是域外天魔，那对付国盟就简单多了。
楚成认真说道，“你想啊，这些材料，还有那些吃的，以往三十六域都没有，凭啥他林东方一冒出来，就啥都有了？”
“而且你看看他黑石城里那些五花八门的东西，什么电灯，自来水，化肥…”
楚成取出一个充电小台灯，打开后让书房内锃亮锃亮的。
看着那一个个璀璨的小灯珠，贾德居然有种要被亮瞎眼的感觉。
这可比灵石灯亮堂多了！
“这…恐怕林东方来自一个不可思议的世界，他很可能是域外天魔！”
贾德谨慎了一下，没有顺着楚成的思路去实锤林东方。
万一这场对话被记录下来，交给林东方的话…
贾德还不想被林东方那个狗皮膏药赖上。
“我也只是说个假设，如果他真是域外天魔，那我必将和贾盟主一道，扞卫我九天三十六域的安危。”

楚成说的跟什么一样，就差天降神光被他衬托成救世主了。
贾德尬笑了两下，他下意识认为楚成这是从林东方那里捞到了足够的好处，想过河拆桥了。
content_en:
"I wonder what the names of these new road materials, Your Majesty, are? Why have I never seen them before?"
Judd quickly adjusted his attitude and asked the question with a smile.
Chu Cheng introduced it generously, "This is a good thing, it's incredibly cheap, and it's strong and durable. Look at how fast the people's carriages and horses can run on it..."
This guy kept praising the asphalt road for a long time, but he didn't mention his name.
The secretary on the side was writing furiously, recording all the details meticulously!
These are all the ‘great achievements’ of His Majesty the Emperor!
At the end of the day, Chu Chengcai took a cup of tea from the side to moisten his throat and said,
"This thing is called asphalt, and it's very useful!"
Seeing that the smile on Judd's face had froze, Chu Cheng sneered inwardly.
Don’t you, old boy, like to be a smiling tiger? Then just keep smiling.
I’ll make your face paralyze with laughter!
"Asphalt..."
A trace of surprise flashed in Judd's eyes, as if he had thought of something.
Seeing this, Chu Cheng deliberately asked, "With Leader Jia's expression on his face, could it be that he has heard of asphalt before? This is a material recently developed by Chef Lin. It's interesting to say that he is a chef who doesn't study recipes, but instead studies these things."
Lin Dongfang had told him before that whenever anyone asked, just tell him that he bought it from Black Rock City and there was no need to hide it.
Judd shook his head repeatedly, "I've never heard of asphalt."
Chu Cheng snorted in his heart. Judd had to listen to what he said. If he said he hadn't heard of it, then he had.
‘With Judd’s expression, he may have seen this name by chance somewhere, and he will probably leave in a hurry. ’
Sure enough, Judd raised his hands and said, "I passed by Youguo today to come and bother me, and now I want to..."
"Hey, what Chief Jia said is too polite. How can this be considered harassment? Come on, come on, you and I, brothers, go somewhere quiet to chat."
With a smile on his face, Chu Cheng grabbed Judd's arm like a real brother and pulled him towards the imperial city.
Judd's face turned green when he saw the dragon energy that protected the city condensed from the vast popularity in the direction of the imperial city.
That thing is not a killing array, but it is better than a killing array!
The soles of Judd's feet left two ravines on the asphalt road, and he was dragged into the imperial city by Chu Cheng.
Entering the study, Chu Cheng dismissed all his officials and said mysteriously to Judd,
"Leader Jia, I suspect that Lin Dongfang is one of the extraterrestrial demons!"
"How can I see it?"
Judd was stunned. He didn't expect that Chu Cheng brought him here just to talk about this.
He didn't want to leave while talking about this.
If it can be confirmed that Lin Dongfang is an extraterritorial demon, it will be much easier to deal with the National Alliance.
Chu Cheng said seriously, "Think about it, these materials and food were not available in the thirty-six regions in the past. Why does Lin Dongfang have everything when he appears?"
"And look at the various things in Blackstone City, such as electric lights, running water, fertilizers..."
Chu Cheng took out a small rechargeable desk lamp and turned it on, making the study room bright.
Looking at the bright little lamp beads, Judd actually felt like he was going to be blinded.
This is much brighter than the spirit stone lamp!
"This... I'm afraid Lin Dongfang comes from an incredible world. He is probably an extraterrestrial demon!"
Judd was cautious and did not follow Chu Cheng's idea to attack Lin Dongfang.
If this conversation is recorded and given to Lin Dongfang...
Judd doesn't want to be relied on by Lin Dongfang's dog-skin plaster yet.
"I'm just making a hypothesis. If he is really an extraterrestrial demon, then I will definitely work with Leader Jia to defend the safety of my Nine Heavens and Thirty-Six Domains."
What Chu Cheng said was the same, except for the divine light from heaven that made him the savior.
Judd laughed twice. He subconsciously thought that Chu Cheng had gained enough benefits from Lin Dongfang and wanted to burn bridges.
